title: FRIENDSHIP
tod: A week compressed: 11:40 → 13:10, several days elided through light changes
logline: Three people become a unit. And underneath it, a phone buzzes — and the audience learns something Ishaan does not.
grade: The warmest the school will ever look. Sun patches on the floor grow imperceptibly as the week advances — the only time-passing device allowed.

narration.hi: कुछ दिनों में मीरा हमारी क्लास का हिस्सा बन गई। कबीर को बात करने का बहाना मिल गया, और मुझे... बस देखने का।
narration.en: In a few days Meera became part of our class. Kabir found an excuse to talk to her, and I found… an excuse to watch.

narration.hi: एक दोपहर उसके फ़ोन पर एक मैसेज आया। उसने पढ़ा, मुस्कुराई, और फ़ोन जेब में रख दिया। मैंने कुछ नहीं पूछा।
narration.en: One afternoon a message arrived on her phone. She read it, smiled, and slipped the phone back into her pocket. I didn't ask anything.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.20 m, behind Meera's right shoulder onto the desk she shares with Ishaan
shots.move: Slow 15° arc — the camera slowly chooses Meera's side of the frame.
shots.action: Meera slides her notebook across so Ishaan can copy a diagram. He starts to copy, gets a line wrong, and she taps the page with a pencil, correcting him.
shots.expr: Meera: matter-of-fact, no flirting. Ishaan: a 3-second glance at her hand, then back to the page.
shots.env: Desk, open notebook, pencil box, a steel water bottle.
shots.light: Warm window key from frame-right; notebook paper slightly blown out.
shots.cont: PROPOSED (non-canon): sharing a notebook and the pencil-tap correction. Consistent with the brief's 'notebook sharing' beat.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.50 m, in the corridor, side-on to them, lockers/notice board behind
shots.move: Static; the three move through the frame right to left.
shots.action: Kabir finishes a story with a big gesture; Meera laughs openly, head back; Ishaan laughs one beat later, watching her laugh rather than the joke.
shots.expr: Genuine, unguarded. Let the audience see that he is laughing at HER laugh.
shots.env: L05 corridor mid-block, hard sun rectangles on the floor, one hanging fan.
shots.light: Striped light; their shadows fall left and stay consistent with S05-04.
shots.cont: Kabir between them in this shot — the series' enduring composition: Kabir centre, the other two either side of a gap.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.40 m, low front three-quarter on Ishaan at the desk
shots.action: He writes, stops, looks up and left (toward Meera's bench), catches himself, and resumes writing — but the pen doesn't move.
shots.expr: The small, private smile he will not admit to.
shots.env: Desk, page, his own hand shadow.
shots.light: Warm key, 3:1; the brightest point in frame is the notebook.
shots.vo: Silence across the whole shot — the narration is deliberately absent here.
shots.cont: Eyeline must match S06-05/06-06 to the degree.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.55 m, from behind the three of them at the open corridor arch
shots.move: Very slow dolly-in from behind, 0.2 m/s — we join them rather than watch them.
shots.action: Three backs at the arch, looking out at the playground. Meera points at something; Kabir leans to see; Ishaan doesn't look at what she's pointing at.
shots.expr: Faces unseen — posture only. This is the friendship image the series will return to.
shots.env: Corridor arch, deep background of the playground, tree, white sky.
shots.light: Backlit; the interior is cool, the outside is blown white.
shots.vfx: Atmospheric haze in the outdoor background.
shots.cont: PROPOSED (non-canon): this friendship tableau. Flagged for approval; harmless to remove.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.30 m, across the bench at Meera, Ishaan's shoulder as foreground mass
shots.action: Her phone buzzes on the desk. She turns it face-up, reads, and a completely different smile arrives — smaller, softer, private.
shots.expr: The smile must be visibly DIFFERENT from the laugh in S07-02. Softer eyes, no teeth, slightly downward.
shots.env: Desk, phone face-down then face-up, a stack of textbooks.
shots.light: Warm; the screen glow adds a tiny cool bounce to her chin — the one cool light in the scene.
shots.vfx: Faint screen glow on her fingers only.
shots.vo: Line 2 at 18:02 — begins exactly as she reads.
shots.cont: PHONE LOCK: plain dark-grey case, no visible logos, no readable text on screen ever. Never show the sender, never show the name (CONT-MEERA-01).

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.30 m, 3/4 on Meera from Ishaan's side of the bench
shots.move: Static with breathing; she types two characters and stops.
shots.action: She types a short reply, hesitates, deletes one character, retypes it, then puts the phone away and returns to her book.
shots.expr: The hesitation is the whole story. Eyes flick down-left, then a small resolve.
shots.env: Phone in hand, notebook beneath, Ishaan's out-of-focus shoulder in the corner.
shots.light: Window key; the phone edge catches a thin line of light.
shots.cont: She is NOT hiding the phone from Ishaan — she simply doesn't think of him as someone to hide from yet. Play it innocent.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.32 m, 3/4 on Ishaan, slightly tighter than S07-06
shots.move: Static. End on a 10-frame hold, then cut.
shots.action: He saw. He looks back down at his notebook, adjusts it unnecessarily, and keeps the small smile — but his jaw sets.
shots.expr: Not jealousy. Uncertainty. The performance is entirely in the jaw and the breath.
shots.light: Warm key, slightly dimmer than S07-06 — one-quarter stop down, subliminal.
shots.vo: Silence. The narration stops before the emotional beat, not during it.
shots.cont: Do not add a musical sting. The audio bible forbids it. The jaw must carry it.
